summary: Analyzed 1070 min wall time / 180 experiments (avg 6 min). Both RTX 3090s were completely idle at 0% utilization, meaning DualGPURunner was not utilized and parallelization was missed. Doomed-rerun block on Exp 1663 consumed 82 minutes instead of failing fast. Estimated 40% savings recoverable via DualGPURunner and fail-fast blocks.
slowest_experiments: Exp 1653: NSVIF DSL SOTA GGUF Integration (53min)
bottlenecks_identified: Both GPUs were idle at 0% utilization throughout, indicating a failure to use DualGPURunner for parallel execution.
Doomed-rerun block (Exp 1663) consumed 82 minutes, wasting time instead of failing fast.
Sequential execution bottlenecks on long-running tasks like Exp 1603.
improvements_suggested: Enforce use of DualGPURunner to parallelize workloads across both idle RTX 3090 GPUs.
Implement a fail-fast mechanism for doomed-rerun blocks to emit terminal artifacts immediately.
Optimize sequential bottlenecks in long-running experiments.
meta_reflection: The retrospective highlights a persistent failure to utilize available GPU resources for parallelization. Enforcing DualGPURunner and fixing the doomed-rerun blocks are critical to recovering efficiency.
